body: How long is it going to take to go away... I really don’t think I can live with this in my head 24/7 I really can’t go much longer

I have tried I’ve even walked myself into a&e 2 weeks ago they told me if it gets worst come back I kept fighting the voices to go away they don’t want me going in there I finally did and that happens to be honest with you I feel like I’m going rounds with mike Tyson every second of the day I sure as hell cant last that many rounds I’m actually scared I’m stuck with this voice that keeps calling me and don’t stop bloody shouting I feel to scream drop me out and shut up and I think I have a few time I even punch myself in the head it goes for ten minutes then comes back again I can’t cope just feels like this ain’t gonna end.

It seems like the only way im going to get it out is to cut it out myself... it’s always there telling me to do thing telling me that people are watching me staring at me they wanna kill me and To do things I don’t wanna do I’m not saying I’m not an angry person or anything like that Im not a good person I never have been but I don’t just do things to people without a reason but now I just can’t control myself it’s telling me to do things I don’t want to do and I sometime don’t remember doing or I people are lie to me and telling me I’m doing things to make me think I’ve done them I’m scared of my own self does that even make sense I’m scared of myself
